text:
Zoe: quick note — while walking a newcomer through the "Get started" flow, the init script in examples/hello/init.sh sets REDWOOD_API_KEY but the README refers to REDWOOD_TOKEN. newbies hit 401s on first deploy.
Harish: thanks. which paths?
Zoe: examples/hello/init.sh, docs/quickstart/hello-onboard.md, and .github/workflows/hello.yml have inconsistent env names.
Mei: oy. can we do a single PR to unify to REDWOOD_API_KEY, add a tiny smoke check, and update the GH Actions example to show secrets usage (`REDWOOD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}`)?
Harish: yes. also add a short one-liner in the quickstart: "Set REDWOOD_API_KEY (token starting with sk-) before first deploy." and fix the init script to be idempotent.
Zoe: plan: 1) update snippets to REDWOOD_API_KEY 2) add examples/hello/ci/auth_smoke.sh that validates token format and optionally calls /v1/whoami when a real token is present 3) add a docs-ci job that runs the smoke script in stub mode in CI.
Mei: can you also grep for REDWOOD_TOKEN across docs and attach the report in the PR so reviewers can see the sweep output?
Zoe: yes. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999 — includes snippet fixes, smoke script, GH Actions example, and grep artifact.
docs-ci-bot: docs CI started for PR 999 (job: docs-ci)
docs-ci-bot: snippet-lint passed; grep found 2 occurrences of REDWOOD_TOKEN in legacy tutorial — updated those in branch.
deploy-bot: docs build succeeded for PR 999 (job: docs-ci, duration: 2m 5s)
Harish: LGTM. Mei — can you sanity-check the init.sh idempotency and the GH Actions snippet formatting?
Mei: checked locally, init script now uses `mkdir -p` and `sed -i` to replace vars safely. GH Actions snippet uses `env:` block with `REDWOOD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}`. all good.
Zoe: i'll merge and add a blurb to the release notes under "Onboarding: quickstart fixes". opening follow-up issue to add a docs linter rule to catch REDWOOD_TOKEN in snippets.
Harish: thank you — should cut initial support noise. closing thread after merge.
